storage: Keep in a dry airtight container away from the stove and damp; iodised salt loses iodine if it gets hot and wet.
looksLike: Fine white free-flowing crystals in a 1 kg pouch; iodised table salt has potassium iodate or iodide added.
howToPick: Look for "iodised" and the FSSAI mark on a sealed, dry pouch; the salt should flow freely and be dry and white.
shelfLife: Salt does not spoil; iodine slowly declines with heat, moisture and light, so use within about a year and keep sealed (general guidance).

usedIn.raw: 0.3 g in the dough and 0.4 g in the filling
0.5 g per serving (black salt 0.3 g is separate)
2 g for the rice water and 2.5 g for the masala (4.5 g)
1 g in the marinade and 1.5 g in the pot (2.5 g)
5 g in the pasta water and 1.5 g in the sauce
